answer: A payout is split so that 49% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The tide schedule is applied in wharf and nadir shows each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1253 identities would post 1321 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
